# Q3 Financial & Operations Summary Report

## Executive Summary
This document outlines key performance indicators, revenue growth, and operational milestones achieved during the third quarter of 2026.

## Highlights
- Total revenue increased by 28% year-over-year.
- Customer satisfaction rating reached 94.6%.
- Expansion into 3 new regional hubs completed successfully.

## Department Updates
### Engineering & Product
The team delivered 4 major releases including the automated unstructured file ingestion pipeline.

### Sales & Operations
Customer retention improved across enterprise accounts with 12 new enterprise signups.
